Build Hermit and the focused test binaries used by the privileged lane
steps.description: MEM-CAP DERIVATION 2026-08-04 (follow-on to task memory-caps-must-scale-with-job-count / #1583, which MISSED this privileged-lane build node): pinned_jobs=8 literal via CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8 prefix on BOTH build commands (was unset -> both cargo build and cargo test --no-run defaulted their build phase to nproc; that cc1plus fan-out is the OOM class the pin bounds; the job-pin is the actual fix). After the bin build, the content-addressed publisher verifies source type/mode/size, hashes before and after copying, verifies the published hash and atomically updates the pointer before any later Cargo invocation can relink target/debug/hermit. This KVM-only lane deliberately publishes a binary-only artifact; unlike portable DBT/SaBRe/LiteInst cells, it does not consume install_pkg resources. Cap KEPT at the existing generous 8.0GiB: a warm/incremental measurement read peak_bytes~1.64GiB @j8, but that reused build.workspace artifacts and UNDER-estimates a cold from-scratch privileged build, so the 8.0GiB headroom is retained rather than tightened on an unreliable warm figure. rss_baseline=5.0GiB (scheduling reservation). hermit@b384187e.
steps.cmd: CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8 cargo build -p hermit --features third-party-backends --bin hermit && ./ci/publish-hermit-e2e-artifact.sh target/debug/hermit target/ci/hermit-e2e-artifacts target/ci/hermit-e2e-artifact.path && CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8 cargo test -p hermit-detcore --test tests_misc --no-run

steps.desc: CPUID-faulting smoke: Detcore masks host RDRAND/RDSEED feature bits
steps.description: REQUIRES A MACHINE FACILITY, DECLARED 2026-08-12 (hermit#2135, hermit#2148, hermit#2205). rdrand_rdseed_is_masked can only observe Detcore masking host feature bits if the kernel can trap the guest's CPUID, which needs arch_prctl(ARCH_SET_CPUID, 0) to succeed. Where it cannot, this node used to FAIL in 0.11 s with exit 101 and an empty detail block -- indistinguishable from a broken build -- and its eager-exit aborted the twelve other in-flight nodes and filtered twenty-seven more, so a machine that runs 31 of 33 nodes in 3m22s produced no receipt at all. `requires_host_capability` moves that judgement OUT of the node, to an out-of-band probe run during plan construction, and makes the outcome a third recorded state: host-inapplicable, which is neither a pass nor a failure and is written to the ledger as a typed intentional skip. THIS DOES NOT WEAKEN THE TEST. Where the capability is present the node runs unchanged and its assertions keep full force; the probe fails closed toward running, so a probe error or an unexpected errno still runs it. The capability name is checked against the closed vocabulary in scripts/lib/validate_plan.rs::HostCapability, and an unknown name refuses the whole run.
steps.cmd: status=0; timeout --kill-after=5s 30s cargo test -p hermit-detcore --test tests_misc rdrand_rdseed_is_masked -- --exact || status=$?; if [ "$status" -eq 124 ] || [ "$status" -eq 137 ]; then printf 'test hermit-detcore/tests_misc::rdrand_rdseed_is_masked exceeded 30 s (innermost exact Cargo timeout: exit %s)\n' "$status" >&2; fi; exit "$status"

steps.desc: PMU smoke: retired-conditional-branch overflow delivery and skid measurement
Build the manifest-plan binaries the metadata validation runs
steps.description: COST DRIVER CORRECTED 2026-08-08; budget raised 19s -> 180s. THE PREVIOUS RATIONALE HERE WAS WRONG AND MISLEADING: it derived 19s from a COMPILE measurement, but the cold path this node actually dies on is a NETWORK FETCH. Both privileged reds on main that day (run 31283614686 @ e692a151d, run 31284978438 @ 501b787f3) failed here with one detail line -- 'Updating git submodule https://github.com/rrnewton/dynamorio.git' -- and zero 'Compiling' lines. WHY A TRIVIAL PACKAGE PAYS A HUGE COST: hermit-manifest-plan depends only on serde, serde_json, sha2 and toml, so its own compile really is the measured ~5.4s; but `cargo build -p <member>` must first MATERIALIZE every git dependency in the workspace lock, including git+https://github.com/rrnewton/reverie.git, and the reverie repo carries third-party/dynamorio as a git SUBMODULE. The first cargo invocation of the run therefore checks reverie out into $CARGO_HOME/git/checkouts and recursively fetches DynamoRIO (235 MB; measured on this box 6.3s full clone) plus sabre and e9patch. The runner blew 19s on the DynamoRIO fetch alone. BIMODAL, NOT A REGRESSION: 2f8f8e537, the commit that introduced this node, is an ANCESTOR of edae964e2, which was GREEN at this same 19s budget. The discriminator is cache state, not code. THE DECIDING CACHE IS $CARGO_HOME/git, NOT target/. Each distinct reverie pin gets its own checkout directory, so a pin bump, a cache eviction, or a different self-hosted box makes this node cold however warm target/ is. The old claim that this lane is 'structurally warmer than portable' because the self-hosted checkout persists target/ is true and IRRELEVANT -- target/ is not the cache being missed. WHY 180s, MATCHING PORTABLE: the cost is network+disk materialization of a fixed set of git dependencies, which is lane-INDEPENDENT, so the ~9x compile-speed gap between ubuntu-latest and the self-hosted boxes does not apply and both lanes should budget this node alike. Deliberately generous; the durable fix is to prefetch $CARGO_HOME/git OUTSIDE the DAG's budgeted critical path (filed separately). ARITHMETIC after innermost timeout nesting: this node is on the critical path (setup.manifest_plan -> e2e.metadata -> build.manifest_guests -> e2e.manifest_applications), now 180+180+120+180 = 660s, so the inner launcher is 720s and the job timeout 22 minutes. Do not hand-tune any of these: target/debug/test-harness recomputes the path and both bounds from source, so rerun `target/debug/test-harness validate`.

steps.desc: The 30 run_kvm_ cli tests, which no node ran before
steps.description: SCHEDULES A POPULATION THAT WAS OBSERVED BY NOTHING. hermit-cli/tests/cli.rs defines 30 `run_kvm_` tests. Before this node, ci/dag/portable.json had 57 nodes of which exactly ONE ran `--test cli`, and its cmd carried `--skip run_kvm_`; privileged.json had 9 nodes and none ran the target at all. All 22 were outside every gate at the time, so a defect in one could accumulate indefinitely -- run_kvm_preserves_closed_standard_input was carrying TWO independent faults at once and CI could report neither. THEY GO ON THE PRIVILEGED LANE AND THE PORTABLE SKIP STAYS. Deleting `--skip run_kvm_` from portable's test.cli is the obvious one-token change and it is the wrong one: portable runs on GitHub-managed runners with no evidence of /dev/kvm, and every one of these tests self-guards on Path::new("/dev/kvm").exists() and RETURNS EARLY, so there they would report 30 silent passes -- strictly worse than being unscheduled, because the gap would hide behind green ticks instead of being greppable in the DAG. TWO GUARDS THAT CATCH DIFFERENT THINGS, neither substituting for the other: (1) the cmd OPENS /dev/kvm and fails if it cannot, which is what catches a wrongly-PRESENT capability probe -- an early-returning test still counts as run and passed, so a test COUNT cannot see a guard fire; (2) the cmd asserts 30 tests were SELECTED, which catches either a rename/filter shrink or an unacknowledged growth of the set. `requires_host_capability: kvm` keeps an honest machine without KVM from reporting a false RED, recording host-inapplicable -- a typed intentional skip, neither pass nor fail -- as cpuid.faulting does. Measured on the primary dev host (named in docs/TESTING_ENVIRONMENTS.md under "Named measurement hosts"): /dev/kvm is mode 666, open(O_RDWR) succeeds, KVM_GET_API_VERSION returns 12, and `hermit run --backend kvm` exits 0, so here the guard passes and the tests do real work. Declares resources.kvm so it serializes against the other KVM consumers under this lane's resource_caps.kvm of 1.
steps.cmd: set -uo pipefail; if ! exec 9<>/dev/kvm; then printf 'test.cli_kvm: /dev/kvm could not be opened, so the 32 run_kvm_ tests would self-guard and report silent passes. Refusing rather than reporting a green that measured nothing.\n' >&2; exit 1; fi; exec 9<&-; log=$(mktemp); status=0; ./ci/run-nextest-counted.sh ${CI:+--profile ci} -p hermit --features third-party-backends --test cli -j 1 -E 'test(/^run_kvm_/)' >"$log" 2>&1 || status=$?; cat "$log"; ran=$(sed -n 's/^running \([0-9]\{1,\}\) tests\{0,1\}$/\1/p' "$log" | tail -1); if [ "${ran:-0}" -ne 32 ]; then printf 'test.cli_kvm: expected 32 run_kvm_ tests to be SELECTED, saw %s. A rename or filter change has altered the set; fix the filter or update the expected count deliberately.\n' "${ran:-0}" >&2; rm -f "$log"; exit 1; fi; rm -f "$log"; exit "$status"
